caveats: Alignments come only from OSM route relations and are unverified: a route may be missing, drawn along the wrong roads, or split. VERIFY against iombusandrail.im before relying on them. This is geometry, NOT a timetable.
Membership is partial. One feature is emitted per OSM route relation, so a service whose outbound and return are mapped separately appears as two features and its ref repeats.
